name: Osmious-Mastaba

civilization.name: Meridian Concord
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the south, magnetic pole anomalies. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
There is money in uranium here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
